## Services Offered

- **Tree Removal** — Safe, efficient removal of hazardous or unwanted trees of any size. Free estimates. ([/services/tree-removal](https://murrietatreeexperts.com/services/tree-removal))
- **Tree Trimming & Pruning** — Expert pruning to keep trees healthy, safe, and aesthetically pleasing. ([/services/tree-trimming](https://murrietatreeexperts.com/services/tree-trimming))
- **Stump Grinding** — Complete stump removal below grade to reclaim yard space and eliminate tripping hazards. ([/services/stump-grinding](https://murrietatreeexperts.com/services/stump-grinding))
- **Emergency Tree Service** — 24/7 response for storm-damaged, fallen, or hazardous trees. ([/services/emergency-tree-service](https://murrietatreeexperts.com/services/emergency-tree-service))
